job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
Britton Timbers is a long-established Tasmanian business and one of Australia's largest manufacturers and suppliers of Tasmanian timber and sustainable hardwood products, supplying the construction, architecture, joinery, furniture and manufacturing sectors.
 
With change in the team, an opportunity is now available for an experienced Sales Manager to lead sales functions across Tasmania and key mainland markets. This is a senior, hands-on role suited to a commercially focused sales professional from timber, veneer, manufacturing, engineering, building products or another technical industry.
 
As the timber industry continues to evolve, a key focus of this role will be supporting existing native timber products and customers as well as timbers from the emerging resource of plantation-grown hardwoods. The Role
Reporting to the Managing Director, you will manage major customer relationships, support regional sales teams and identify opportunities to grow sales across existing and new markets.
 
A key part of the role is connecting customer demand with stock availability and production capacity. You will work closely with national branch managers, account managers and production teams across Tasmania and mainland Australia to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.

  • Lead sales activity across Tasmania and mainland Australia.
  • Manage major and national customer relationships.
  • Identify and convert new business opportunities.
  • Support branch managers and account managers across the national network.
  • Work with production teams to align customer demand, stock and production capacity.
  • Maintain oversight of market activity, pricing and customer requirements.
  • Manage pricing reviews in consultation with the Managing Director.
  • Resolve customer, product and supply issues promptly.
  • Improve sales processes, market intelligence and reporting.
  • Provide practical leadership across sales and customer service.
Who We're Looking For
You will be an experienced sales leader with a strong record of sales accountability, growing revenue, managing complex accounts and building long-term customer relationships and bring:
  • Senior sales, business development or account management experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing, engineering, timber, building products, construction supply or another technical sector.
  • The ability to understand technical products and customer specifications.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience working with production, operations or supply teams.
  • The ability to manage major or multi-site customer accounts.
  • A practical approach to leadership and problem-solving.
  • An ability to undertake regular inter-state travel.
Timber industry experience would be well regarded but is not essential. Applications are encouraged from high-performing sales professionals with relevant experience in industrial, manufacturing, technical or engineered products.

  • Access to up to $3,000 per person for training and re-skilling through the Rapid Response Skill Initiative for eligible redundant workers
  • Connections to the Network of Regional Jobs Hubs and a range of additional support services
To be eligible, you must meet all of the below criteria: 
  • have lost Casual, Full-time or Part-time work in the last 12 months due to Business Closure, Business Downsizing or Retrenchment
  • be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident with a Tasmanian Residential address
  • provide written evidence of job loss, redundancy or retrenchment (a Separation Certificate indicating Redundancy or Email/ Written Evidence of Redundancy)
  • If you were employed by Local, State or Australian Government or Government Department, Business or Government Enterprise, you may not be eligible for RRSI funded training.
